This SLIM+ shower waste is extra flat making it ideal for low-profile shower trays. It also includes SMART Membrane Technology. Its external bi-injected washer guarantees a perfect seal. Meaning no more bad smells, pipe noises, and back-siphoning. Both the independent hair catcher and cartridge remover for quick and easy deep cleaning. No more chemical product is needed to clean your shower waste!nWhy do I need a shower waste? Also known as a shower trap, shower wastes help keep your shower clean and hygienic by draining the shower water into external sewage systems. An unreliable shower waste can create puddles of dirty water, leaking, and unpleasant smells. A shower waste works by retaining a certain amount of water, which seals off the gases from the sewer, preventing them from entering your bathroom. When using your shower, the shower water will flow into the drainage creating a vacuum, and slowing down the water's entrance to the drain. The drain should also be vented allowing water to flow freely. Without venting, water may back siphon.nNeed To KnownnDimensions: H40mm x W90mm x L190mmnMaterial: ABSnColour: BlacknFinish: MattnShape: DomenWarranty: 10 YearsnFlow Rate: 32 L/minnSlope: 2% integrated slope for optimal drainagennView User Manual »rn        rn;

Also known as a shower trap, shower wastes help keep your shower clean and hygienic by draining the shower water into external sewage systems. description: The detailsnEnhance your home's heating with our eco-friendly Eco Eleganza Horizontal aluminium designer radiators, the perfect fusion of style, efficiency, and sustainability. Their slim profile fits seamlessly into any space - from cosy bedrooms to spacious living areas - without taking up too much room.nnAvailable in single and double-panel options with standard or middle H Block connection, the Eco Eleganza Flat collection offers a variety of sizes and colours to suit your home's heating needs.
